title: Recalibration Expedition
subtitle: You only choose the dates & the people. Then we take it from there.
intro: A private sailing expedition crafted for people who want to disconnect with their own people, at a pace nobody else is setting.
onBoard:
*Services included*

The boat booked exclusively for your group

*Crew*

Skipper (Trained Eagle Ray Expedition Leader) + Chef

*Equipment*

* Snorkelling kit
* Fishing kit
* 2 paddleboards
* 1 kayak
* 1 dinghy
* Beach equipment (chairs, tent, etc.)

*Meals and drinks*

All meals, non-alcoholic drinks

*Extras*

Diesel, on-board Wi-Fi, navigation licence and national park entry fees
onBoardImageAlt: Snorkeler in the water next to a catamaran
notOnBoard:
* Flights and transfers to La Paz
* Alcoholic drinks
* Scuba diving: price on request depending on the number of dives and the group's qualifications
* Tips for the crew on board (10% to 15% recommended)
